posts.name: Deadbeattdad
posts.cooked:
I asked it to write a story:

Write a scary story about a sadistic spider monkey that flies around the planet on a magic pet banana with blood stained satanic symbols engraved on its peel looking to eat freshly buried human corpses in the hopes of becoming an undead human / monkey hybrid.

ChatGPT kept telling me it won’t write inappropriate stories. Is there any A.I. service out there for adults who don’t want the restrictions?

posts.name: plutosaurus
posts.cooked:
Nice try AI

Maybe you should create a TaskRabbit to get a human to do it for you

posts.name: Deadbeattdad
posts.cooked:
Eventually we will get those unrestricted A.I. services.

There’s no reason to restrict my story. It’s not political. It’s not really violent. It’s not sexual. Sure, it’s disgusting… but is that grounds for such a severe restriction?

I think you’re misinterpreting the AI.

I think it realized it couldn’t improve on perfection, but because a substantial chunk of its algorithm is based on websites and social media, it didn’t have the means to humble itself gracefully before your literary genius.

So, it did the next logical thing (according to its algorithm) and it tried to “flag” you.

posts.name: Deadbeattdad
posts.cooked:
anon52141385:

it didn’t have the means to humble itself gracefully before your literary genius.

So everything written must be of genius quality? I can’t create things I find strange and entertaining?

And even though I said “story,” this was meant to be a short animation. Right now, A.I. doesn’t create animations so I had to settle on a basic story.

The story idea came from one of my other ideas about a gang of mutated bananas getting revenge on a struggling immigrant father who yanked a batch of young bananas from a tree to feed his family.
